entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dongfang Shuo was a Han dynasty scholar-official, fangshi, author, and court jester to Emperor Wu. In Chinese mythology, Dongfang is considered a Daoist xian and the spirit of Venus who incarnated as a series of ancient ministers including Laozi. Dongfang Shuo is depicted in the Wu Shuang Pu by Jin Guliang.
